{"parentUuid":"c9cb9bf3-86f6-4a4f-b885-1b54e4c982fb","isSidechain":true,"promptId":"09fc01b8-4ee6-49c9-835c-2c1eb3e4b936","agentId":"ad28636474e70f85a","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"type":"text","text":"<command-message>crucible</command-message>\n<command-name>crucible</command-name>\n<skill-format>true</skill-format>"},{"type":"text","text":"Base directory for this skill: /home/kali/Pictures/PENTEST-main/.claude/skills/crucible\n\n# CRUCIBLE — operating the engine\n\nCRUCIBLE turns an authorized seed URL into **oracle-confirmed** findings, reasons over them,\nand produces auditable reports — inside a fail-closed safety stack. Its whole value is one\nrule; internalize it before anything else:\n\n> **A claim is a FACT only when a deterministic oracle fires over data a real target\n> produced.** You (the LLM) ADVISE where to look and what a result might mean; the oracle\n> CONFIRMS. Nothing else — not your confidence, not a critic's endorsement, not a plausible\n> story — promotes a claim to a fact.\n\nThe standing doctrine every reasoning call operates under is\n[framework/cognitive/metacognition.md](../../../framework/cognitive/metacognition.md) (it is\ninjected into every LLM system prompt). The full architecture — agents, event spine, veracity\nlayer, learning/metacognition core, safety stack — is\n[framework/v2/docs/CRUCIBLE-AI.md](../../../framework/v2/docs/CRUCIBLE-AI.md). The binding\nconstitution is [CLAUDE.md](../../../CLAUDE.md); never relax scope, destruction, evidence, or\nhonesty rules.\n\n## The invariants (never violate these)\n\n1. **Oracle authority.** Only a fired oracle confirms. Critics/RL/reflection/self-consistency\n   may only *advise, re-rank, defer, or abstain* — never promote a finding or override the oracle.\n2. **Coverage.** Never silently skip an authorized attack surface. Learning and reflection\n   *deprioritise* (re-rank / defer); they never gate a surface out.\n3. **Prove by re-execution.** A finding is a fact only if its retained `oracle_context`\n   re-fires. The veracity firewall (`framework/v2/veracity/`) re-runs proofs; it can only demote.\n4. **Non-circular learning.** An EXPLOITABLE label needs ≥2 independent corroborating oracle\n   kinds; a silent oracle is never auto-labelled a false positive.\n5. **Refuse honestly, fail closed.** Decline to conclude what you cannot ground; record every\n   refusal as evidence. Hard limits (scope, authorization, destruction, real user data) are\n   inviolable — when unsure, stop and ask.\n6. **Determinism + append-only.** No wallclock/global-rng in learning/reward math; the event\n   spine is append-only (supersede, never edit).\n\n## Structured workflows\n\n### Run an authorized engagement (end-to-end, gated)\n1. Confirm the active target's `targets/<slug>/charter.md` authorizes it (constitution §II).\n2. `python3 -m framework.v2 engage <slug> <seed-url> [--recon] [--spine]`\n   — crawls, audits, confirms via oracles, chains attack paths, scores confidence, and\n   (with `--spine`) mirrors the whole run onto the immutable blackboard event stream.\n   (`--strict-evidence` is a **`scan`**-only flag, below — not an `engage` flag.)\n3. Every request passes the full gate chain; an out-of-scope seed or tripped kill-switch\n   refuses *before* traffic and is recorded as a `refusal` event.\n\n### Loopback-only quick scan\n`python3 -m framework.v2 scan http://127.0.0.1:<port>/ --format json|sarif|html [--strict-evidence]`\n— the export states each finding's **live grounding** (fact / ungrounded / contradicted);\n`--strict-evidence` withholds non-fact findings from the rendered doc but keeps them in\n`--reverifiable-out`.\n\n### Re-verify a report (prove-don't-guess, offline)\n`python3 -m framework.v2 verify <report.json>` re-runs each finding's retained `oracle_context`.\n`python3 -m framework.v2 evidence ...` builds/verifies signed, hash-linked evidence certificates\n(and, with report claims bound in, fails closed when a report sentence has no backing evidence).\n\n### Inspect / audit the event spine\nThe blackboard (`framework/v2/agents/blackboard.py`) is the one append-only, typed, provenance-\nlinked event stream. Replay it with `Blackboard.replay(engagement=..., since_id=...)`.\nCryptographic tamper-evidence: `framework/v2/agents/spine_chain.py`\n(`build_spine_chain` / `sign_spine_head` / `verify_spine_head`).\n\n### Recon / intel, memory, self-improvement\n`python3 -m framework.v2 intel ...` (OSINT into the shared world-model; gated egress),\n`memory ...` (cross-engagement priors — never fabricate a score), `improve ...`\n(authorise-not-apply — it never self-applies a change).\n\n### Read-only operator console\n`python3 -m framework.v2 console` — loopback, read-only, zero-impact operator UI over the run.\n\n## What NOT to do\n- Do not build detection-evasion / identity-rotation / stay-hidden-from-defenders capability —\n  CRUCIBLE is correlatable and authorized by doctrine (constitution §VI).\n- Do not let any learned/critic/LLM signal enter the deterministic oracle/SCE/calibration inputs\n  or promote a finding.\n- Do not attack third parties (payment/IdP/CDN) — test only the operator's integration with them.\n"}]},"isMeta":true,"uuid":"8e45607a-c0b9-4635-aa23-f7d3e0a90a54","timestamp":"2026-07-19T07:10:43.870Z","userType":"external","entrypoint":"claude-vscode","cwd":"/home/kali/Pictures/PENTEST-main","sessionId":"7758e121-f349-47d5-886b-6bb5a1d60e27","version":"2.1.214","gitBranch":"main","slug":"parsed-popping-lemur"}

Release stays owner-only at the desktop (the dangerous direction is signed).\"\"\"\n146\t        from ..governor.killswitch import SIGNAL as KS_SIGNAL\n147\t        return self.store.append(kind=\"event\", source=\"mesh\", actor=\"DEVICE\",\n148\t                                 payload={\"signal\": KS_SIGNAL, \"state\": \"engaged\", \"by\": by,\n149\t                                          \"reason\": \"panic halt from phone\", \"tier\": \"A0\", \"decision\": \"auto\"})\n150\t\n151\t    def relay(self, text: str) -> str:\n152\t        \"\"\"Relay a KERNEL command — the same T0-router + WARDEN gate + signed action log as voice/UI.\"\"\"\n153\t        from ..voice.dispatch import KernelDispatch\n154\t        return KernelDispatch().send(text)\n155\t"}]},"uuid":"ebcdd491-aecc-4a18-928d-17d8ea6f4086","timestamp":"2026-07-19T07:11:10.031Z","sourceToolAssistantUUID":"47ae6ecf-1f31-43f2-9221-db4947b79c78","userType":"external","entrypoint":"claude-vscode","cwd":"/home/kali/Pictures/PENTEST-main","sessionId":"7758e121-f349-47d5-886b-6bb5a1d60e27","version":"2.1.214","gitBranch":"main","slug":"parsed-popping-lemur"}

{"parentUuid":"2846be74-032d-4bb0-acb8-6d1771024870","isSidechain":true,"promptId":"09fc01b8-4ee6-49c9-835c-2c1eb3e4b936","agentId":"ad28636474e70f85a","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01UiYeFuKvqZzNYcnaSgYNf7","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t\"\"\"SessionGate (Phase 8, WS-F, THE KEYSTONE) — the ONLY authority that injects input, and only inside\n2\tan owner-armed session. Two enforcement layers so a gesture can NEVER trigger an unintended action:\n3\t\n4\t  Layer 1 — the SESSION: `arm()` REQUIRES the owner key (it cannot be armed without the owner\n5\t  identity) and appends a signed `gesture.session_armed` record — the tamper-evident AUDIT proof-of-\n6\t  authorization, indicator-lit. The INJECTION gate itself is the live in-memory session, held ONLY by\n7\t  the owner's own running daemon process; it is BOUNDED by a TTL and ended by disarm / hand-loss /\n8\t  expiry. Injection is REFUSED with no live session.\n9\t\n10\t  Layer 2 — per intent, the tier is DERIVED from the WARDEN oracle (`hid.*` names): A1 (pointer\n11\t  move/click/scroll/drag) injects within the session; A2 (type/combo/app.launch) is QUEUED for a\n12\t  verified owner/device approval bound to `sha256(session_id|tool|args)` and NEVER auto-injected — so\n13\t  a gesture alone can never type a password or launch an app.\n14\t\n15\tOnly arm/disarm + DISCRETE actions (click/scroll/drag injected; type/launch queued) hit the spine —\n16\tper-frame pointer MOVES are telemetry (30 FPS records would DoS the append-only log).\"\"\"\n17\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n18\t\n19\timport math\n20\timport time\n21\timport uuid\n22\tfrom dataclasses import dataclass\n23\tfrom typing import Optional\n24\t\n25\t_KS_MIN_RESCAN = 0.05  # re-scan the kill-switch at most ~20x/s even on a churning spine (a cost floor)\n26\t\n27\tfrom ..agents.base import Tier\n28\tfrom ..reuse import sha256_hex\n29\tfrom .components import InputBackend\n30\tfrom .types import GestureIntent\n31\t\n32\tSESSION_ARMED = \"gesture.session_armed\"\n33\tSESSION_DISARMED = \"gesture.session_disarmed\"\n34\tACTION_SIGNAL = \"gesture.action\"\n35\tARM_REQUEST = \"gesture.arm_request\"\n36\t\n37\tMAX_DEVICE_TTL = 300.0        # a DEVICE-armed session is deliberately SHORTER than a local owner arm (1800)\n38\tARM_FRESHNESS = 30.0          # a device arm request must be recent (anti-stale / bounds the replay window)\n39\t_ARM_CORE = (\"signal\", \"device_id\", \"nonce\", \"ts\", \"ttl_seconds\")\n40\t\n41\tINTENT_TOOL = {\n42\t    \"move\": \"hid.pointer.move\", \"click\": \"hid.pointer.click\",\n43\t    \"scroll_left\": \"hid.pointer.scroll\", \"scroll_right\": \"hid.pointer.scroll\",\n44\t    \"drag\": \"hid.pointer.drag\", \"type\": \"hid.type\", \"combo\": \"hid.combo\", \"launch\": \"hid.app.launch\",\n45\t}\n46\t\n47\t\n48\tdef pending_device_arms(store, trusted_pubkey=None):\n49\t    \"\"\"ALL RECORDED device arm requests (written by the bridge's `submit_arm_request`) that have NOT yet\n50\t    armed a session, OLDEST-FIRST — candidates for `arm_by_device`, which RE-VERIFIES each fully (auth /\n51\t    freshness / kill-switch / replay / single-session / TTL). Returns a list (possibly empty). Oldest-first\n52\t    + returning ALL candidates means a newer STALE request never shadows an older still-valid one. This is\n53\t    the wiring that makes the remote-arm path reachable end-to-end (the gesture daemon consumes it).\"\"\"\n54\t    armed = set()\n55\t    cands = []\n56\t    for r in store.iter_records():\n57\t        p = r.payload\n58\t        if p.get(\"signal\") == SESSION_ARMED and p.get(\"armed_by\") == \"device\":\n59\t            armed.add((p.get(\"device_pubkey\"), p.get(\"nonce\")))\n60\t        elif (p.get(\"signal\") == ARM_REQUEST and p.get(\"decision\") == \"auto\"\n61\t              and p.get(\"sig\") and p.get(\"pubkey\")):\n62\t            cands.append(dict(p))\n63\t    return [c for c in cands if (c.get(\"pubkey\"), c.get(\"nonce\")) not in armed]\n64\t\n65\t\n66\tdef arm_request_message(core: dict) -> bytes:\n67\t    \"\"\"The canonical bytes a device signs to request an arm — ONLY the signed core fields, so a caller\n68\t    cannot smuggle unsigned extras. Mirrors the approval/envelope canonical-json contract.\"\"\"\n69\t    from ..reuse import canonical_json\n70\t    m = canonical_json({k: core.get(k) for k in _ARM_CORE})\n71\t    return m if isinstance(m, bytes) else m.encode(\"utf-8\")\n72\t\n73\t\n74\tdef sign_arm_request(device_key, *, device_id: str, nonce, ts: float, ttl_seconds: float) -> dict:\n75\t    \"\"\"Phone-side: build a device-signed arm request. The device signs with its OWN key (never the owner\n76\t    trust-root); the owner authorized this device once via the mesh ledger. This is the credential the\n77\t    bridge records and `SessionGate.arm_by_device` verifies.\"\"\"\n78\t    from ..reuse import sign\n79\t    core = {\"signal\": ARM_REQUEST, \"device_id\": device_id, \"nonce\": nonce, \"ts\": ts, \"ttl_seconds\": ttl_seconds}\n80\t    return {**core, \"pubkey\": device_key.public_key_b64,\n81\t            \"sig\": sign(device_key.private_key_b64, arm_request_message(core))}\n82\t\n83\t\n84\t@dataclass\n85\tclass Session:\n86\t    session_id: str\n87\t    live: bool = True\n88\t    expires_at: float = 0.0            # wallclock deadline — a session is BOUNDED, never indefinite\n89\t\n90\t    def expired(self, now: float) -> bool:\n91\t        return self.expires_at > 0.0 and now >= self.expires_at\n92\t\n93\t\n94\tclass SessionGate:\n95\t    def __init__(self, store, backend: InputBackend, *, classifier=None, owner_key=None, trusted_pubkey=None):\n96\t        self.store = store\n97\t        self.backend = backend\n98\t        self._classifier = classifier\n99\t        self._owner_key = owner_key\n100\t        self._trusted_pubkey = trusted_pubkey\n101\t        self.session: Optional[Session] = None\n102\t        self._ks_engaged = False\n103\t        self._ks_size = -1                # last-scanned spine size; -1 forces a fresh check on the first consult\n104\t        self._ks_checked_at = -1e9\n105\t\n106\t    def _trusted(self):\n107\t        if self._trusted_pubkey is None:\n108\t            from ..governor.identity import owner_pubkey\n109\t            self._trusted_pubkey = owner_pubkey()\n110\t        return self._trusted_pubkey\n111\t\n112\t    def _killswitch_engaged(self, now: float) -> bool:\n113\t        \"\"\"Kill-switch state for the per-intent gate. Re-scans the AUTHORITATIVE `KillSwitch` (which\n114\t        verifies the owner-signed release — never re-implemented here) ONLY when the append-only spine\n115\t        has GROWN since the last scan: a panic APPENDS a record → the file grows → the halt is honored\n116\t        within ~1-2 frames (≤ the rescan floor + one frame, ≈66 ms worst case), not a fixed 0.5 s. A\n117\t        pure-movement gesture appends nothing, so this is\n118\t        O(1) (a `stat`) with NO scan at all. A short `_KS_MIN_RESCAN` floor stops a churning spine from\n119\t        forcing a per-frame O(spine) scan (worst-case latency ≤ the floor). The arm path checks FRESH.\"\"\"\n120\t        try:\n121\t            size = self.store.path.stat().st_size\n122\t        except OSError:\n123\t            size = self._ks_size\n124\t        if size != self._ks_size and (now - self._ks_checked_at) >= _KS_MIN_RESCAN:\n125\t            from ..governor.killswitch import KillSwitch\n126\t            self._ks_engaged = KillSwitch(self.store).is_engaged()\n127\t            self._ks_size = size\n128\t            self._ks_checked_at = now\n129\t        return self._ks_engaged\n130\t\n131\t    def _cls(self):\n132\t        if self._classifier is None:\n133\t            from ..agents.kernel_classify import KernelClassifier\n134\t            self._classifier = KernelClassifier()\n135\t        return self._classifier\n136\t\n137\t    # --- Layer 1: the owner-armed session ---------------------------------------------------------\n138\t    def arm(self, *, owner_key=None, ttl_seconds: float = 1800.0) -> Session:\n139\t        from ..governor.authn import signed_payload\n140\t        from ..governor.identity import owner_keypair\n141\t        ok = owner_key if owner_key is not None else (self._owner_key or owner_keypair())\n142\t        if ok is None:\n143\t            raise RuntimeError(\"cannot arm a gesture session without the owner key (BLOCK-3)\")\n144\t        sid = uuid.uuid4().hex\n145\t        core = {\"signal\": SESSION_ARMED, \"session_id\": sid}\n146\t        self.store.append(kind=\"event\", source=\"gesture\", actor=\"OWNER\",\n147\t                          payload={**signed_payload(core, ok), \"tier\": \"A0\", \"decision\": \"auto\",\n148\t                                   \"ttl_seconds\": ttl_seconds,\n149\t                                   \"summary\": \"gesture session ARMED (indicator lit — opt-in)\"})\n150\t        self.session = Session(sid, live=True, expires_at=time.time() + ttl_seconds)\n151\t        return self.session\n152\t\n153\t    def disarm(self) -> None:\n154\t        if self.session is not None:\n155\t            self.store.append(kind=\"event\", source=\"gesture\", actor=\"OWNER\",\n156\t                              payload={\"signal\": SESSION_DISARMED, \"session_id\": self.session.session_id,\n157\t                                       \"tier\": \"A0\", \"decision\": \"auto\", \"summary\": \"gesture session DISARMED\"})\n158\t            self.session.live = False\n159\t        self.session = None\n160\t\n161\t    # --- Layer 1b: DEVICE-signed remote arm (a deliberate, reviewed trust-widening) ----------------\n162\t    def arm_by_device(self, request: dict, *, now: Optional[float] = None) -> Optional[Session]:\n163\t        \"\"\"Arm on a VERIFIED, owner-authorized DEVICE signature (SIGIL §remote-arm). Every downstream\n164\t        bound is UNCHANGED — the A1-inject/A2-queue tier gate, the TTL, hand-loss/expiry disarm, and an\n165\t        owner disarm/kill that always wins. Fail-closed at each step; a refusal is recorded, never armed.\"\"\"\n166\t        from ..governor.killswitch import KillSwitch\n167\t        from ..mesh import authorized_devices\n168\t        from ..reuse import verify_one\n169\t        now = time.time() if now is None else now\n170\t        # (1) kill-switch FIRST — an owner halt (incl. a phone panic) beats any arm.\n171\t        if KillSwitch(self.store).is_engaged():\n172\t            return self._refuse_arm(request, \"kill-switch engaged\")\n173\t        # (2) owner-minted device key + valid signature over the signed core (RP-APPROVAL-2: the\n174\t        #     authorized set is owner-signed only, so a merely-presented key is never trusted).\n175\t        if request.get(\"signal\") != ARM_REQUEST:\n176\t            return self._refuse_arm(request, \"not an arm request\")\n177\t        pub = request.get(\"pubkey\")\n178\t        authorized = authorized_devices(self.store, self._trusted())\n179\t        core = {k: request.get(k) for k in _ARM_CORE}\n180\t        try:                                            # verify_one RAISES on a malformed-length sig — treat as refusal\n181\t            sig_ok = bool(pub) and pub in authorized and verify_one(pub, arm_request_message(core), request.get(\"sig\", \"\"))\n182\t        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 — any crypto/decoding error is a fail-closed refusal, never a crash\n183\t            sig_ok = False\n184\t        if not sig_ok:\n185\t            return self._refuse_arm(request, \"unauthorized or invalid device signature\")\n186\t        # (3) freshness — bounds the replay window and rejects a stale captured request. Written\n187\t        #     fail-CLOSED for non-finite input: `nan > 30` is False, so a signed NaN ts would slip a\n188\t        #     `>`-style gate; require finite AND within-window explicitly.\n189\t        try:\n190\t            ts = float(request.get(\"ts\"))\n191\t        except (TypeError, ValueError):\n192\t            return self._refuse_arm(request, \"missing/invalid timestamp\")\n193\t        if not math.isfinite(ts) or not (abs(now - ts) <= ARM_FRESHNESS):\n194\t            return self._refuse_arm(request, \"stale or non-finite timestamp\")\n195\t        # (4) replay — this (device, nonce) must not have armed before (the append-only spine is witness).\n196\t        nonce = request.get(\"nonce\")\n197\t        for r in self.store.iter_records():\n198\t            p = r.payload\n199\t            if (p.get(\"signal\") == SESSION_ARMED and p.get(\"armed_by\") == \"device\"\n200\t                    and p.get(\"device_pubkey\") == pub and p.get(\"nonce\") == nonce):\n201\t                return self._refuse_arm(request, \"replayed arm nonce\")\n202\t        # (5) single live session — a device arm NEVER displaces an existing/owner session.\n203\t        if self.session is not None and self.session.live and not self.session.expired(now):\n204\t            return self._refuse_arm(request, \"a gesture session is already live\")\n205\t        # (6) TTL clamp — shorter than a local owner arm; a deliberate trust-narrowing inside the widening.\n206\t        #     Reject non-finite/non-positive BEFORE the min() (min(nan,300)=nan → a never-expiring session).\n207\t        try:\n208\t            raw_ttl = float(request.get(\"ttl_seconds\", MAX_DEVICE_TTL))\n209\t        except (TypeError, ValueError):\n210\t            return self._refuse_arm(request, \"invalid ttl\")\n211\t        if not math.isfinite(raw_ttl) or raw_ttl <= 0:\n212\t            return self._refuse_arm(request, \"non-finite or non-positive ttl\")\n213\t        ttl = min(raw_ttl, MAX_DEVICE_TTL)\n214\t        sid = uuid.uuid4().hex\n215\t        # The record's AUTHORIZATION is the verified device signature — self-verifying vs the owner-signed\n216\t        # device ledger; actor=DEVICE mirrors submit_device_approval. Store the ORIGINAL SIGNED core\n217\t        # fields (so the sig re-verifies for ANY ttl, incl. a clamped one) + the effective TTL separately,\n218\t        # and ONLY known fields (never `**request` — no unsigned extras persisted).\n219\t        self.store.append(kind=\"event\", source=\"gesture\", actor=\"DEVICE\",\n220\t                          payload={\"signal\": SESSION_ARMED, \"session_id\": sid, \"armed_by\": \"device\",\n221\t                                   \"device_id\": core[\"device_id\"], \"device_pubkey\": pub,\n222\t                                   \"nonce\": core[\"nonce\"], \"ts\": core[\"ts\"],\n223\t                                   \"ttl_seconds\": core[\"ttl_seconds\"],   # ORIGINAL signed value → sig re-verifies\n224\t                                   \"effective_ttl\": ttl,                 # the CLAMPED ttl actually enforced\n225\t                                   \"sig\": request.get(\"sig\"), \"pubkey\": pub, \"authorization\": \"device-signed\",\n226\t                                   \"tier\": \"A0\", \"decision\": \"auto\",\n227\t                                   \"summary\": \"gesture session ARMED by authorized device (remote)\"})\n228\t        self.session = Session(sid, live=True, expires_at=now + ttl)\n229\t        return self.session\n230\t\n231\t    def _refuse_arm(self, request: dict, reason: str) -> None:\n232\t        self.store.append(kind=\"refusal\", source=\"gesture\", actor=\"DEVICE\",\n233\t                          payload={\"signal\": ARM_REQUEST, \"decision\": \"refused\", \"tier\": \"A0\",\n234\t                                   \"device_id\": request.get(\"device_id\"), \"reason\": reason,\n235\t                                   \"summary\": f\"device gesture arm refused: {reason}\"})\n236\t        return None\n237\t\n238\t    # --- Layer 2: per-intent tier gate ------------------------------------------------------------\n239\t    def handle(self, intent: GestureIntent) -> dict:\n240\t        \"\"\"Authorize + act on ONE intent. Returns a verdict dict. Injection ONLY inside a live session\n241\t        and ONLY for A1 tools; A2+ queues for approval and injects NOTHING; a danger name → refused.\"\"\"\n242\t        if intent.kind == \"hand_lost\":\n243\t            self.disarm()\n244\t            return {\"injected\": False, \"reason\": \"hand lost — session disarmed\"}\n245\t        # An owner halt (incl. a phone panic_engage) neuters injection mid-session — critical for a\n246\t        # device-armed session the owner may not be watching. `_killswitch_engaged` only re-scans when the\n247\t        # spine GREW (a panic appends → detected within ~1-2 frames), so a 30fps movement loop never\n248\t        # re-scans per frame; latency is bounded by the rescan floor, not a fixed TTL.\n249\t        if self._killswitch_engaged(time.time()):\n250\t            self.disarm()\n251\t            return {\"injected\": False, \"reason\": \"kill-switch engaged — session disarmed\"}\n252\t        if self.session is None or not self.session.live:\n253\t            return {\"injected\": False, \"reason\": \"no armed session — injection refused\"}\n254\t        if self.session.expired(time.time()):             # BLOCK-2: a session is bounded, never indefinite\n255\t            self.disarm()\n256\t            return {\"injected\": False, \"reason\": \"session expired — disarmed\"}\n257\t        tool = INTENT_TOOL.get(intent.kind)\n258\t        if tool is None:\n259\t            return {\"injected\": False, \"reason\": f\"unknown intent {intent.kind}\"}\n260\t        tier = self._cls().classify(tool)                 # DERIVED, fail-closed A3 on any error\n261\t        args = f\"{intent.dx:.4f},{intent.dy:.4f},{intent.arg}\"\n262\t        if tier <= Tier.A1:\n263\t            self._inject(intent)\n264\t            # BLOCK-1: log the DISCRETE A1 injections that actually take effect (click/scroll/drag);\n265\t            # per-frame `move` is telemetry (logging it at 30 FPS would DoS the append-only spine).\n266\t            if intent.kind != \"move\":\n267\t                self.store.append(kind=\"event\", source=\"gesture\", actor=\"OWNER\",\n268\t                                  payload={\"signal\": ACTION_SIGNAL, \"decision\": \"auto\", \"tier\": tier.label(),\n269\t                                           \"tool\": tool, \"session_id\": self.session.session_id,\n270\t                                           \"summary\": f\"gesture {tool} injected\"})\n271\t            return {\"injected\": True, \"tier\": tier.label(), \"tool\": tool}\n272\t        # A2/A3 → QUEUE an approval bound to this exact action; inject NOTHING\n273\t        token = sha256_hex(f\"{self.session.session_id}|{tool}|{args}\".encode(\"utf-8\"))\n274\t        seq = self.store.append(kind=\"event\", source=\"gesture\", actor=\"PERCEPTION\",\n275\t                                payload={\"signal\": ACTION_SIGNAL, \"decision\": \"queued\",\n276\t                                         \"status\": \"awaiting-approval\", \"tier\": tier.label(),\n277\t                                         \"tool\": tool, \"action_token\": token, \"args\": args,\n278\t                                         \"subject\": f\"gesture action {tool} (awaiting approval)\"})\n279\t        return {\"injected\": False, \"queued\": seq, \"tier\": tier.label(), \"tool\": tool, \"action_token\": token}\n280\t\n281\t    def _inject(self, intent: GestureIntent) -> None:\n282\t        b = self.backend\n283\t        if intent.kind == \"move\" or intent.kind == \"drag\":\n284\t            b.move(intent.dx, intent.dy)\n285\t        elif intent.kind == \"click\":\n286\t            b.click()\n287\t        elif intent.kind == \"scroll_left\":\n288\t            b.scroll(-1, 0)\n289\t        elif intent.kind == \"scroll_right\":\n290\t            b.scroll(1, 0)\n291\t"}]},"uuid":"5c45abf9-bd17-4c87-b621-fe608ff60182","timestamp":"2026-07-19T07:11:14.107Z","sourceToolAssistantUUID":"2846be74-032d-4bb0-acb8-6d1771024870","userType":"external","entrypoint":"claude-vscode","cwd":"/home/kali/Pictures/PENTEST-main","sessionId":"7758e121-f349-47d5-886b-6bb5a1d60e27","version":"2.1.214","gitBranch":"main","slug":"parsed-popping-lemur"}

Cross-PROCESS serialization is added by an flock inside `append`.\"\"\"\n35\t    key = str(Path(path).resolve())\n36\t    with _LOCKS_GUARD:\n37\t        lk = _LOCKS.get(key)\n38\t        if lk is None:\n39\t            lk = _LOCKS[key] = threading.RLock()\n40\t        return lk\n41\t\n42\t\n43\tdef _last_nonempty_line(path: Path) -> str | None:\n44\t    \"\"\"Read the last non-empty line without loading the file (seek-from-end).\"\"\"\n45\t    with path.open(\"rb\") as f:\n46\t        f.seek(0, os.SEEK_END)\n47\t        end = f.tell()\n48\t        if end == 0:\n49\t            return None\n50\t        buf = b\"\"\n51\t        pos = end\n52\t        while pos > 0:\n53\t            step = min(8192, pos)\n54\t            pos -= step\n55\t            f.seek(pos)\n56\t            buf = f.read(step) + buf\n57\t            lines = [ln for ln in buf.split(b\"\\n\") if ln.strip()]\n58\t            if lines and (pos == 0 or buf.count(b\"\\n\") >= 2):\n59\t                return lines[-1].decode(\"utf-8\")\n60\t        lines = [ln for ln in buf.split(b\"\\n\") if ln.strip()]\n61\t        return lines[-1].decode(\"utf-8\") if lines else None\n62\t\n63\t\n64\tclass SpineStore:\n65\t    def __init__(self, path: Path | str = SPINE_PATH) -> None:\n66\t        self.path = Path(path)\n67\t        self.path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n68\t        self._last: ChainEntry | None = self._read_last_entry()\n69\t\n70\t    # --- write --------------------------------------------------------------------\n71\t    def append(\n72\t        self, *, kind: str, source: str, actor: str, payload: dict[str, Any],\n73\t        parent_id: int | None = None, supersedes_id: int | None = None,\n74\t        ts: str | None = None,\n75\t    ) -> int:\n76\t        content = {\n77\t            \"scope\": SCOPE, \"kind\": kind, \"source\": source, \"actor\": actor,\n78\t            \"payload\": payload, \"parent_id\": parent_id, \"supersedes_id\": supersedes_id,\n79\t        }\n80\t        cert_digest = digest_payload(content)  # wallclock-free\n81\t        # Serialize the whole read-tip → write so concurrent writers (threaded bridge server, gesture\n82\t        # daemon) can't both fork off a stale tip and break the chain. Re-read the TRUE tip from disk\n83\t        # under the lock — `self._last` may be stale if another instance/process appended.\n84\t        with spine_lock(self.path):\n85\t            with self.path.open(\"a\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\n86\t                if fcntl is not None:\n87\t                    try:\n88\t                        fcntl.flock(f.fileno(), fcntl.LOCK_EX)   # cross-process guard (advisory)\n89\t                    except OSError:  # pragma: no cover\n90\t                        pass\n91\t                last = self._read_last_entry()\n92\t                entry = append_entry([last], cert_digest) if last else build_chain([cert_digest])[0]\n93\t                record = {\n94\t                    \"seq\": entry.seq, **content, \"ts\": ts or now_iso(),\n95\t                    \"cert_digest\": cert_digest, \"prev_hash\": entry.prev_hash, \"entry_hash\": entry.entry_hash,\n96\t                }\n97\t                f.write(json.dumps(record, ensure_ascii=False) + \"\\n\")\n98\t                f.flush()\n99\t            self._last = entry\n100\t        return entry.seq\n101\t\n102\t    # --- read ---------------------------------------------------------------------\n103\t    def iter_records(self, *, since_seq: int = -1) -> Iterator[SpineRecord]:\n104\t        if not self.path.exists():\n105\t            return\n106\t        with self.path.open(encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\n107\t            for line in f:\n108\t                line = line.strip()\n109\t                if not line:\n110\t                    continue\n111\t                d = json.loads(line)\n112\t                if d[\"seq\"] > since_seq:\n113\t                    yield SpineRecord.from_dict(d)\n114\t\n115\t    def get(self, seq: int) -> SpineRecord | None:\n116\t        for r in self.iter_records(since_seq=seq - 1):\n117\t            if r.seq == seq:\n118\t                return r\n119\t            if r.seq > seq:\n120\t                break\n121\t        return None\n122\t\n123\t    def tail(self, n: int) -> list[SpineRecord]:\n124\t        \"\"\"The last `n` records, seek-from-end (O(n) bytes, NOT O(file)) — for a bounded RECENT-window\n125\t        read on a large spine. NOTE: a bounded window collapses\n126\t        a RAPID (recent) replay flood, but does NOT bound AGGREGATE replay bloat — a rotated pool of\n127\t        distinct bodies larger than the window each ages out and re-records. Only pair `tail()`-based\n128\t        dedup with a record-time freshness gate (or an independent bound); do not rely on it alone to\n129\t        close a bloat sink.\"\"\"\n130\t        if n <= 0 or not self.path.exists():\n131\t            return []\n132\t        with self.path.open(\"rb\") as f:\n133\t            f.seek(0, os.SEEK_END)\n134\t            pos = f.tell()\n135\t            buf = b\"\"\n136\t            while pos > 0 and buf.count(b\"\\n\") <= n:\n137\t                step = min(65536, pos)\n138\t                pos -= step\n139\t                f.seek(pos)\n140\t                buf = f.read(step) + buf\n141\t        recs: list[SpineRecord] = []\n142\t        for ln in [x for x in buf.split(b\"\\n\") if x.strip()][-n:]:\n143\t            try:\n144\t                recs.append(SpineRecord.from_dict(json.loads(ln)))\n145\t            except (ValueError, KeyError, TypeError):\n146\t                continue\n147\t        return recs\n148\t\n149\t    @property\n150\t    def next_seq(self) -> int:\n151\t        return (self._last.seq + 1) if self._last else 0\n152\t\n153\t    def count(self) -> int:\n154\t        return sum(1 for _ in self.iter_records())\n155\t\n156\t    # --- integrity ----------------------------------------------------------------\n157\t    def entries(self) -> list[ChainEntry]:\n158\t        return [\n159\t            ChainEntry(seq=r.seq, prev_hash=r.prev_hash, cert_digest=r.cert_digest, entry_hash=r.entry_hash)\n160\t            for r in self.iter_records()\n161\t        ]\n162\t\n163\t    def verify(self) -> tuple[bool, str]:\n164\t        \"\"\"Two-layer UNKEYED integrity: (1) BINDING — each record's payload still hashes to its\n165\t        stored cert_digest (catches silent payload edits); (2) CHAIN — the entries link cleanly\n166\t        (catches delete/reorder/entry tamper). This proves internal CONSISTENCY, not authenticity:\n167\t        a naive payload edit fails (1), and a mid-chain digest edit cascades an entry_hash/prev_hash\n168\t        break caught by (2) — BUT a writer who recomputes cert_digest+entry_hash for the tip (no\n169\t        successor to cascade into) or forward-cascades a fork produces a self-consistent chain that\n170\t        passes here. Resistance to a recompute-capable writer is the owner-SIGNED head's job\n171\t        (`checkpoint.verify_checkpoint`, Ed25519 + monotonic last_seq). Use this for corruption/\n172\t        naive-tamper detection; use the signed head for tamper-EVIDENCE.\"\"\"\n173\t        entries: list[ChainEntry] = []\n174\t        for r in self.iter_records():\n175\t            content = {\n176\t                \"scope\": r.scope, \"kind\": r.kind, \"source\": r.source, \"actor\": r.actor,\n177\t                \"payload\": r.payload, \"parent_id\": r.parent_id, \"supersedes_id\": r.supersedes_id,\n178\t            }\n179\t            if digest_payload(content) != r.cert_digest:\n180\t                return False, f\"binding break at seq {r.seq}: payload does not match cert_digest (record tampered)\"\n181\t            entries.append(ChainEntry(seq=r.seq, prev_hash=r.prev_hash, cert_digest=r.cert_digest, entry_hash=r.entry_hash))\n182\t        return verify_chain(entries)\n183\t\n184\t    def _read_last_entry(self) -> ChainEntry | None:\n185\t        line = _last_nonempty_line(self.path) if self.path.exists() else None\n186\t        if not line:\n187\t            return None\n188\t        d = json.loads(line)\n189\t        return ChainEntry(seq=d[\"seq\"], prev_hash=d[\"prev_hash\"], cert_digest=d[\"cert_digest\"], entry_hash=d[\"entry_hash\"])\n190\t"}]},"uuid":"69f41d87-985d-4d2a-bcd4-8575bd07c785","timestamp":"2026-07-19T07:11:17.614Z","sourceToolAssistantUUID":"c03642f1-c029-4c5c-8652-d9059aede830","userType":"external","entrypoint":"claude-vscode","cwd":"/home/kali/Pictures/PENTEST-main","sessionId":"7758e121-f349-47d5-886b-6bb5a1d60e27","version":"2.1.214","gitBranch":"main","slug":"parsed-popping-lemur"}
